text:
sophie: Hey — trying to land PR #2678 (tiny routing fix) before the APAC deploy blackout at 00:00 UTC tomorrow. CI is stuck in the linux queue. Can someone help prioritize or take merge if green? :wave:

matt: @sophie I can handle the merge if CI passes. Do you know which job is the blocker?

sophie: Looks like e2e-linux and integration-api are queued; unit + smoke already green locally. Queue ETA from dashboard ~30m. Link: https://ci.internal/redwood/queue/2678

kevin: I can try to nudge the workers but I'm finishing another rollback. @release-oncall can you allocate some linux-workers to this PR?

release-oncall: Oncall here — I can bump the linux-worker pool for 20m. Please re-run the job once I confirm.

matt: Thanks — I'll re-run once you say go. Also tagging the PR with a short rollback plan in case canary looks off.

ci-bot: ci-bot: Build queued for PR #2678 -> assigned to linux-worker-12. Watch logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/2678/1

sophie: Added rollback steps to PR body and a manual canary flag. Plan: soft-merge + 10% canary traffic, monitor latency for 30m, then full rollout if stable. If e2e flaps, we hold and rebase after the blackout window.

ci-bot: ci-bot: Build running on linux-worker-12. integration-api in progress.

matt: If integration-api flakes, let's try a single re-run instead of full matrix; keeps time low. Also please leave notes in the PR about the APAC blackout window so CS knows.

ci-bot: ci-bot: All checks passed for PR #2678 (build 2678.1). Artifacts uploaded to s3://ci-artifacts/2678/1

matt: :thumbsup: LGTM. Merging now and kicking off canary. I'll watch logs for the next 30m.

sophie: :rocket: merged at 1704028799. I'll follow up in the morning with canary metrics. Huge thanks to oncall and infra for the fast bump.

kevin: Nice — glad we could avoid the blackout scramble.

release-oncall: np, will scale back the pool in 10m.

sophie: closing the loop — added a brief postmortem note in the PR about the CI queue and the workaround. Good to know for future APAC-friendly merges.
